description: This file defines the DebugControllerDispatcher class, which acts as a communication layer between the DebugController object and external channels. It manages event subscriptions, method calls, and cleanup related to debugging functionalities within the Playwright core project.

classes.name: DebugControllerDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that interfaces with a DebugController instance, handling events and method calls over a communication channel.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with the connection and debug controller objects, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the debug controller with coding scheme parameters.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Enables or disables state change reporting.

methods.name: setRecorderMode
methods.description: Sets the recorder mode of the debug controller.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights a UI element or component during debugging.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and disposes of the debug controller object.
